    We are happy to welcome you to Orient Spa Hanoi! You can make a reservation at our spa by one of the following ways:

    • Calling our phone number
    • Sending us message on Whatsapp, Kakao, Wechat, Zalo
    • Book online on our website and receive instant confirmation

    Online Booking

    You can book for a maximum of 10 guests at one time on our online booking platform. Simply choose:

    • Spa location you want to book
    • Number of guests
    • Date and time
    • Services and duration

    Our staff will send you a confirmation email or message as soon as we receive your booking.

    BOOK NOW!

    About reservation

    If you have any pre-existing health conditions such as lower back pain, skin conditions, injuries, pregnancy, etc. please inform us in advance so we can tailor the best service for you.

    About change / cancellation of reservation

    Please make changes or cancel at least 24​ hours prior to the appointment.​ This allows us to have enough time to properly receive other guests’ booking.

    About payment

    Payment can be made in cash or with credit cards. Payment is made after the treatment. Tips are not required but always welcomed.
